plans.name: Moderato
plans.note: Agent credit values are approximate based on typical task token consumption and are for reference only. All membership features share a single credit pool metered by token usage; credits refresh automatically each month. Kimi Code has a separate 5-hour / weekly rate limit, but this page does not state its numeric limit.
